# Tutorial CODEX

## Pull Request Policy
- Every PR must have a clear "Test Plan" section.
- Issue references (e.g., Fixes #123) are required for non-trivial changes.

## Accessibility Standards
- Do not use clickable `<div>` elements. Use `<button>` or `<a>` for interactivity.
- All interactive elements must have clear focus states.

## Coding Standards
- Avoid inline styles. Use CSS modules or utility classes.
